name: mirage
text: On it. Your screenshot is a DET/CHA market where you hold both sides and Novig shows no payout, 21 days old. Open 193 bets total. I'm checking why PropLine's scores (already a fallback grader) don't reach back that far and why the both-sides rule didn't settle it. Will add a fallback that grades old games from PropLine's historical results and, for bets no source can grade, tells you plainly instead of leaving them as Open. I'll report what I ship.
